senses.definition: the quality of being at hand when needed
convenient for use or disposal
examples: the house is available after July 1
2000 square feet of usable office space

senses.definition: not busy; not otherwise committed
examples: he was not available for comment
he was available and willing to accompany her

senses.definition: obtainable or accessible and ready for use or service
examples: kept a fire extinguisher available
much information is available through computers
available in many colors
the list of available candidates is unusually long

senses.definition: a line of approach
examples: they explored every avenue they could think of
it promises to open new avenues to understanding

senses.definition: a wide street or thoroughfare
approximating the statistical norm or average or expected value
examples: the average income in New England is below that of the nation
of average height for his age
the mean annual rainfall

senses.definition: around the middle of a scale of evaluation
examples: an orange of average size
intermediate capacity
medium bombers

senses.definition: lacking exceptional quality or ability
examples: a novel of average merit
only a fair performance of the sonata
in fair health
the caliber of the students has gone from mediocre to above average
the performance was middling at best

senses.definition: lacking special distinction, rank, or status; commonly encountered
examples: average people
the ordinary (or common) man in the street

senses.definition: relating to or constituting the middle value of an ordered set of values (or the average of the middle two in a set with an even number of values)
examples: the median value of 17, 20, and 36 is 20
the median income for the year was $15,000

senses.definition: relating to or constituting the most frequent value in a distribution
examples: the modal age at which American novelists reach their peak is 30

senses.definition: (sports) the ratio of successful performances to opportunities
a statistic describing the location of a distribution
examples: it set the norm for American homes

senses.definition: an intermediate scale value regarded as normal or usual
examples: he is about average in height
the snowfall this month is below average

senses.definition: achieve or reach on average
examples: He averaged a C

senses.definition: amount to or come to an average, without loss or gain
examples: The number of hours I work per week averages out to 40

senses.definition: compute the average of
(usually followed by ‘to’) strongly opposed
examples: antipathetic to new ideas
averse to taking risks
loath to go on such short notice
clearly indisposed to grant their request

senses.definition: pertaining to or characteristic of birds
(often followed by ‘for’) ardently or excessively desirous
examples: avid for adventure
an avid ambition to succeed
fierce devouring affection
the esurient eyes of an avid curiosity
greedy for fame

senses.definition: marked by active interest and enthusiasm
examples: an avid sports fan

senses.definition: declare invalid
examples: The contract was annulled
void a plea

senses.definition: prevent the occurrence of; prevent from happening; to protect from or to keep away anything undesirable; to ward off
examples: Let's avoid a confrontation
head off a confrontation
avert a strike

senses.definition: refrain from certain foods or beverages
examples: I keep off drugs
During Ramadan, Muslims avoid tobacco during the day

senses.definition: refrain from doing something

senses.definition: stay clear from; keep away from; keep out of the way of someone or something
examples: Her former friends now avoid her
